고속도로.x: The highways are always really jammed during the holidays.

놓치다.m: to miss (a bus, a chance), to lose hold of
놓치다.ex: 아침에 늦게 일어나서 학교 버스를 놓쳤어요.
놓치다.x: I woke up late this morning and missed the school bus.
놓치다.e: From 놓다 (to let go) plus an intensifying -치-: to let something slip away.
rel: to put down, to let go

검색하다.x: Try looking up words you don't know on the internet.
검색하다.t: Pronounced [검새카다]; use it for online searches, and 찾다 for looking for things in general.

믿다.ex: 저는 무슨 일이 있어도 친구의 말을 믿어요.
믿다.x: No matter what happens, I believe what my friend says.
믿다.e: The noun 믿음 'faith, trust' comes from 믿- + -음.

현명하다.x: The harder things get, the more wisely you need to judge.

차가 막히다.forms: 차가 막혀요 · 차가 막혔어요 (casual: 차 막혀)
차가 막히다.m: traffic is heavy, to be stuck in traffic
차가 막히다.ex: 금요일 저녁에는 차가 막혀서 지하철을 타요.
차가 막히다.x: Traffic is bad on Friday evenings, so I take the subway.
차가 막히다.e: Literally 'the cars are blocked'; 막히다 is the passive of 막다 'to block'.
차가 막히다.t: Pronounced [마키다] — ㄱ followed by ㅎ becomes ㅋ.

조깅.ex: 저는 매일 아침 공원에서 조깅을 해요.
조깅.x: I go jogging in the park every morning.

관습.x: Customs for greeting people differ from country to country.
관습.e: Literally 'accustomed habits' — what a society usually does.
관습.t: 관습 is a society's convention; a personal habit is 습관, the same syllables reversed.

개성.ex: 요즘 젊은 사람들은 개성을 중요하게 생각해요.
개성.x: Young people these days value individuality.

닿다.ex: 키가 작아서 손이 선반에 안 닿아요.
닿다.x: I'm short, so my hand doesn't reach the shelf.
닿다.t: Pronounced [다타], and the ㅎ goes silent before vowels: 닿아요 [다아요].

웨딩드레스.ex: 결혼식 때 입을 웨딩드레스를 고르러 갔어요.
웨딩드레스.x: I went to choose a wedding dress to wear at the wedding.
웨딩드레스.t: Brides usually rent rather than buy, and many couples wear it months earlier for studio wedding photos (웨딩 촬영).

반짝이다.m: to twinkle, to sparkle, to glitter
반짝이다.x: The stars are twinkling in the night sky.
반짝이다.e: Mimetic 반짝 'a brief glint' + -이다, a suffix that turns mimetic words into verbs. Dark-vowel 번쩍이다 is a bigger, stronger flash.
반짝이다.t: Pronounced [반짜기다]: the final ㄱ links to the next vowel. 반짝거리다 means the same; 반짝반짝 is the adverb.

조각가.x: Rodin is a French sculptor famous for 'The Thinker'.

무책임하다.ex: 약속을 안 지키는 것은 무책임한 행동이에요.
무책임하다.x: Not keeping your promises is irresponsible behavior.

대략.forms: 대략 + number (대략 백 명); noun: 대략적인 내용
대략.ex: 서울에서 부산까지 기차로 대략 세 시간 걸려요.
대략.x: It takes roughly three hours from Seoul to Busan by train.
대략.e: Literally 'the big outline': the rough picture without details.

만끽하다.m: to enjoy to the fullest, to savor
만끽하다.x: During my vacation, I fully enjoyed the relaxed pace in Jeju.
만끽하다.t: Pronounced [만끼카다]. Common objects: 자유, 여유, 휴가, 봄.

음악가.ex: 그는 세계적인 음악가가 되는 것이 꿈이에요.
음악가.x: His dream is to become a world-famous musician.

애정.ex: 그는 제자들에게 깊은 애정을 가지고 있어요.
애정.x: He has deep affection for his students.

초석.ex: 이 협정은 평화의 초석을 다지는 계기가 될 것입니다.
초석.x: This agreement will be an opportunity to lay the foundation for peace.
초석.e: Literally 'foundation stone' placed under a pillar.
초석.t: Formal word; common collocations are 초석을 다지다 and 초석을 놓다, 'to lay the foundation.'

본방사수.m: watching a show live when it first airs
본방사수.ex: 오늘 마지막 회라서 꼭 본방사수할 거예요.
본방사수.x: It's the final episode today, so I'm definitely watching it live.
본방사수.e: 본방(송) 'original broadcast' + 사수 'defending to the death'.
본방사수.t: Casual. Stars and fans post 본방사수! to boost ratings, since live viewing counts toward 시청률.

의정서.x: Many countries signed the Kyoto Protocol.

실학.m: Silhak, the Practical Learning movement (late Joseon)
실학.x: Jeong Yak-yong is a scholar who greatly developed Practical Learning.
실학.e: Literally 'real learning' — scholarship aimed at practical problems, not abstract theory.

퇴행.ex: 동생이 태어나자 아이에게 퇴행 행동이 나타났어요.
퇴행.x: When the baby sibling was born, the child showed regressive behavior.

알칼리성.x: Soap is alkaline, so it feels slippery when you touch it.

자연선택.x: Darwin explained the evolution of living things through natural selection.

강제징용.ex: 강제징용 피해자들은 지금도 일본의 사과를 요구하고 있어요.
강제징용.x: Victims of forced labor are still demanding an apology from Japan.

전통혼례.x: The two held a traditional wedding at a hanok.
전통혼례.t: Pronounced [전통홀례] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ. The verb is 올리다: 혼례를 올리다.

굴복하다.m: to yield, to submit, to give in
굴복하다.x: He never gave in to the pressure, right to the end.

간명하다.ex: 선생님은 어려운 개념을 간명하게 설명해 주셨어요.
간명하다.x: The teacher explained the difficult concept simply and clearly.
간명하다.t: 간명하다 stresses clarity, 간결하다 stresses brevity — both praise good writing.

유착하다.m: to collude, to be in cozy ties (with); to adhere (medical)
유착하다.ex: 일부 공무원이 기업과 유착해 특혜를 준 사실이 드러났습니다.
유착하다.x: It came to light that some officials had colluded with companies and granted them favors.
유착하다.e: Literally 'heal and stick together' — tissues fusing, then figuratively improper ties.
유착하다.t: 정경유착 'cozy ties between government and business' is a fixed news term.

일렁이다.m: to sway, to roll (waves), to flicker; (feelings) to stir
일렁이다.ex: 바람이 불자 호수의 물결이 잔잔하게 일렁였어요.
일렁이다.x: When the wind blew, the lake's ripples gently swayed.
일렁이다.e: From the mimetic word 일렁일렁 (gently swaying) + -이다.
일렁이다.t: Feelings can 일렁이다 too: 마음이 일렁이다 'my heart stirs'.

연전연승.m: winning every battle, an unbroken winning streak
연전연승.ex: 우리 팀은 이번 시즌에 연전연승을 거두고 있어요.
연전연승.x: Our team has been winning game after game this season.
연전연승.e: Literally 'fight after fight, win after win.'
연전연승.t: Usually used with 거두다 or 하다: 연전연승을 거두다 'to win one victory after another.'
